transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I just... I've had this really heavy feeling lately. I can't seem to shake it. It's just... hopeless, I guess. 

It feels like everything I tried to build after my divorce just... collapsed. And I'm just sitting under it. So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Did this heavy, hopeless feeling start after your divorce?
Um... yeah. A little while after, I guess. It's been... about a month now. It really started when all the financial mess hit... after it was finalized. It's just been hanging over me since then.
Do these feelings seem mainly tied to the financial fallout from the divorce?
I mean... I guess so. It's just... a lot to deal with. Everything costs so much, and... I just don't see how I'm going to fix it. So... yeah. Mostly that.
Over the past month, have you felt down or depressed most days?
Yeah. Most days. It's just... always there. That heavy feeling I mentioned. Like I'm just... stuck under it.
If the financial problems were resolved, do you think this heavy, hopeless feeling would mostly lift?
I don't know. Maybe. I mean... I guess it would help, but... I'm not really sure if it would completely go away. It's hard to tell.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?
I guess so. I just... haven't really felt like doing much of anything lately.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
...Yeah. Just... sometimes I think it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. It got... pretty intense lately. I actually scared myself. I ended up calling the employee assistance program at work.
Before your divorce, had you ever gone through another period like this where you felt depressed most days for at least a couple of weeks?
...No. I don't think so. I mean, I've had stressful times before, but... nothing like this. Not where it just wouldn't go away.
Have you made a plan to end your life?
...No. I haven't... I haven't figured out how I'd do it or anything. Just... just the thoughts.
When you have those thoughts, do you feel like you might act on them?

...I don't know. Like I said before... they just got really strong recently. Strong enough that I got scared I might do something... which is why I called that help line at work. I just... I really didn't want to wake up. But I don't know if I'd actually do it.
Have you been feeling worthless?

...Yeah. I guess so. I just... I keep thinking about how I'm a terrible engineer. And a failed wife. Just... a burden to everyone. I replay every little missed calculation at work, or... or every tense email. It just feels like proof that I ruin things.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?

...Yeah. It's been really hard. I'll just... I'll look at a basic drainage calculation, or... or a spreadsheet I've used for years, and... my mind just blanks. I just sit there rereading the same numbers over and over. I can't... I don't trust any decision I make with it.
Have these symptoms lasted at least two weeks?
...Yeah. About that long. Just... going from being so intensely wired to... crashing like this. It's felt out of control for about two weeks now.
Have you noticed a big change in your appetite lately?
...No. Not really. I guess I just eat what I usually eat. I haven't really thought about it.
Have you been having trouble sleeping?

...Yeah. It hasn't been great. I just... I end up lying awake a lot, staring at the ceiling. Just replaying bills and... mistakes I've made at work. Or if I do manage to drop off, I'm awake before dawn. Just... feeling like I never actually slept.
Have other people noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking noticeably slower than usual?
...No. I don't think so. I mean... no one has really said anything to me about that.
Have you been feeling tired or like you have very little energy lately?

...Yeah. I guess so. It's just... getting through a normal workday right now feels... I don't know, like dragging wet concrete. Just heavy. And... I don't know, even basic things. Like taking a shower or... just opening my laptop... it just takes more energy than I seem to have.
Before this crash, did you have a period where you felt unusually energized or wired compared with your normal self?

...Yeah. I guess. I felt... weirdly wired for a while. Like everything was finally clicking. Or... I don't know, I was also just snapping at people in meetings. Over tiny comments that wouldn't normally bother me. But... yeah, I guess I was.
During that wired period, did you need much less sleep than usual and still feel okay?

...Yeah. I suppose. For a few nights... I was only getting maybe two or three hours. But I felt fine. Sharp enough to just keep working, anyway. It just... I don't know, sleep kind of felt like an inefficient use of time.
During that wired period, did you feel unusually confident in yourself or your abilities?

...I guess. I don't know, I just... I felt like I could handle everything. Like, all at once. I actually thought I could... just outthink it all. Fix my finances, turn around a few projects at work that were going bad... maybe even start putting myself out there as some kind of sustainability expert. It just... seemed totally doable at the time.
